question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Bargain
solution:
The correct answer is '**Deal**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• '**Bargain**' refers to an agreement between two or more parties as to what each party will do for the other. It often relates to discussions of the terms and conditions of a transaction, typically aiming at a fair price or distribution. (सौदा or मोल-भाव)

 
 
• **Example**: "She managed to strike a **bargain **at the local market, getting the goods at half the price."
 
 
 
• '**Deal**' implies an agreement entered into by two or more parties for their mutual benefit, especially in a business or political context. (सौदा or समझौता)
 
 
• **Example**: "The company made a profitable **deal **with the overseas client."
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct synonym for '**bargain**' is '**deal**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is- "**Option 3**".

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Alert**: This term signifies the state of being watchful and ready to respond to a situation. (सतर्क)
 
• **Revoke**: It denotes the official cancellation of a decree, decision, or promise. (रद्द करना)
 
• **Real**: Meaning genuine or authentic. (वास्तविक)
